name: Rule whether a first interview may run while the compensation mechanics read "being finalized"
text_content:
Type: founder decision

The record's transparency sheet is handed at the first interview with "everything needed to decide," including the compensation mechanics, and the record elsewhere says the mechanics are still being finalized (finding 15.3, section 7.4 item 6). The two leads are in the building at least six weeks before dinner's gate, so their first interviews fall months before Session 13 can ratify the architecture. The team recommends yes for the pre-opening cohort's leads, with the record's commitments stated in full and the candidate told the mechanics arrive before any offer, and no for any offer: no offer is made and no start date is committed on a sheet whose item 6 is unfilled (P35, section 12.6, readiness rows 46 and 47). Row 46 reads as failed while this is unruled, not waived. Brandon and Dominic close it; Session 13's architecture closes it for good. Fourth in the order.

Filed by Session 5 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhm4. Reasoning lives on the S5 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.

comment.text: Session 13 adds what the architecture makes possible: item 6 can be handed at a first interview as the whole mechanism (the two layers, one pool per day, the four inputs and the refused inputs, the day's definition, the daily calculation in words, the payment rhythm, the markers, the pay page, and where a question goes) with its values marked unset, which is more than the record's "being finalized" and less than an offer needs. The team recommends that a first interview may run in that state for the pre-opening leads and that no offer goes before the values are set, extending Session 5's P35 with the mechanism now supplied. Brandon and Dominic close it. S13 page, section 13.5; P39, P40.
